title: Beyond the Vote: When Do LLMs Add Value to Retrieval-Based Tabular Classification?
abstract: arXiv:2610.29520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict tabular labels from similar examples, but it remains unclear whether LLM inference improves on direct voting over those same examples. We address this question by comparing four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) using identical retrieved neighbors across 19 tabular classification datasets. With the number of demonstrations fixed, enlarging the retrieval candidate pool improves accuracy for all predictors, yet Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size. More detailed analyses reveal that LLM gains are concentrated where retrieved neighbors exhibit low label consensus and vary across models. These gains further depend on the average feature-space distance to the test query: under low label consensus, some LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in close and intermediate neighborhoods, but

translated_title: 超越投票：大语言模型何时能为基于检索的表格分类增加价值？
translated_abstract: 基于检索的上下文学习（ICL）使大语言模型（LLM）能够从相似示例中预测表格标签，但LLM推理是否比直接对相同示例进行投票更优仍不清楚。我们通过将四个通用LLM与距离加权最近邻投票（Distance-KNN）在19个表格分类数据集上使用完全相同的检索邻居进行比较来解答这一问题。在演示样本数量固定的情况下，扩大检索候选池可以提升所有预测器的准确率，但Distance-KNN在每个候选池规模下都取得了最高的平均准确率。更细致的分析显示，LLM的收益主要集中在检索邻居标签一致性较低的场景，且在不同模型之间存在差异。这些收益还进一步取决于测试查询在特征空间中的平均距离：在低标签一致性情况下，部分LLM在近邻和中等距离邻域中优于Distance-KNN，但……
tldr: 该研究在19个表格分类数据集上将大语言模型与距离加权最近邻投票进行系统比较，发现Distance-KNN整体平均准确率最高，LLM仅在检索邻居标签一致性低且测试样本距离较近或中等时才有优势。
en_tdlr: Comparing LLMs with Distance-KNN on 19 tabular classification datasets, this study finds Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy overall, with LLM gains concentrated only in low label consensus scenarios and close-to-intermediate feature-space neighborhoods.
